subject: Weather, Seasons & Nature
english: What I like most about spring is not just the colour, but the feeling that everything is opening up again.
portuguese: O que mais gosto na primavera não é só a cor, mas a sensação de que tudo se está a abrir outra vez.
pronunciationNote: oo k mysh GOSH-too nah pree-mah-VEH-rah nown eh soh ah kor, mahz ah sen-sah-SOWN d k TOO-doo s esh-TAH ah ah-BREER OH-trah vez

exampleSentences.portuguese: Depois do inverno, essa mudança nota-se até no humor das pessoas.
exampleSentences.english: After winter, you can even notice that change in people's mood.

subject: Weather, Seasons & Nature
english: I do not mind heat on holiday, but day-to-day it drains my energy much faster than cold does.
portuguese: Não me importo com calor nas férias, mas no dia a dia tira-me energia muito mais depressa do que o frio.
pronunciationNote: nown m eem-POR-too kong kah-LOR nazh FAY-ree-ash, mahz noo dee-ah ah DEE-ah TEE-rah-m eh-nehr-ZHEE-ah MOOY-too mysh deh-PREH-sah doo k oo FREE-oo

exampleSentences.portuguese: Com muito calor, sinto que o dia fica logo mais pesado.
exampleSentences.english: With a lot of heat, I feel the day immediately becomes heavier.

subject: Weather, Seasons & Nature
english: I have become much more aware of how light changes my mood across the year.
portuguese: Tenho ficado muito mais consciente de como a luz me muda o humor ao longo do ano.
pronunciationNote: TEN-yoo fee-KAH-doo MOOY-too mysh konsh-SYEN-t d KOH-moo ah looz m MOO-dah oo oo-MOR ow LONG-goo doo AH-noo

exampleSentences.portuguese: Quando os dias encolhem, noto logo diferença na minha energia.
exampleSentences.english: When the days shrink, I notice the difference in my energy straight away.

subject: Weather, Seasons & Nature
english: The kind of weather I struggle with most is not dramatic weather, but weather that feels heavy and airless.
portuguese: O tipo de tempo com que mais custo a lidar não é o tempo dramático, mas o tempo pesado e sem ar.
pronunciationNote: oo TEE-poo d TEM-poo kong k mysh KOOSH-too ah lee-DAR nown eh oo TEM-poo drah-MAH-tee-koo, mahz oo TEM-poo peh-ZAH-doo ee seng ar

exampleSentences.portuguese: Quando o ar parece parado, custa-me muito mais concentrar-me.
exampleSentences.english: When the air feels still, it is much harder for me to concentrate.

subject: Weather, Seasons & Nature
english: I like landscapes that feel lived in, where nature and human presence are clearly intertwined.
portuguese: Gosto de paisagens que parecem habitadas, onde a natureza e a presença humana estão claramente misturadas.
pronunciationNote: GOSH-too d pie-ZAH-zhensh k pah-REH-seng ah-bee-TAH-dash, ON-d ah nah-too-reh-zah ee ah preh-ZEN-sah oo-MAH-nah esh-TOWN klah-RAH-men-t mees-too-RAH-dash
notes: Useful in travel and nature conversation.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Campos, muros antigos e trilhos dizem-me mais do que um cenário totalmente selvagem.
exampleSentences.english: Fields, old walls, and paths speak to me more than a completely wild setting.

subject: Weather, Seasons & Nature
english: If the forecast looks uncertain, I would rather adapt the plan than spend the whole day fighting the weather.
portuguese: Se a previsão parece incerta, prefiro adaptar o plano do que passar o dia inteiro a lutar contra o tempo.
pronunciationNote: s ah preh-vee-ZOWN pah-REH-s een-SER-tah, preh-FEE-roo ah-dap-TAR oo PLAH-noo doo k pah-SAR oo dee-ah een-TAY-roo ah loo-TAR KON-trah oo TEM-poo

exampleSentences.portuguese: Mudar a rota custa menos do que insistir num passeio que já nasceu torto.
exampleSentences.english: Changing the route costs less than insisting on an outing that started off badly.

subject: Weather, Seasons & Nature
english: The best kind of summer evening is the one that is still warm but finally light enough to breathe properly.
portuguese: O melhor tipo de fim de tarde de verão é aquele que ainda está quente, mas já leve o suficiente para se respirar bem.
pronunciationNote: oo meh-LYOR TEE-poo d feeng d TAR-d d veh-ROWN eh ah-KEH-l k een-DAH esh-TAH KEN-t, mahz zhah LEH-v oo soo-fee-see-EN-t PAH-rah s resh-pee-RAR beng

exampleSentences.portuguese: Quando o calor deixa de apertar, até a cidade parece outra.
exampleSentences.english: When the heat stops pressing down, even the city feels different.

subject: Weather, Seasons & Nature
english: I am less interested in postcard views than in places that slowly reveal detail the longer you stay with them.
portuguese: Interesso-me menos por vistas de postal do que por lugares que revelam detalhe aos poucos quanto mais tempo ficamos com eles.
pronunciationNote: een-teh-REH-soo-m MEN-oosh poor VEESH-tash d posh-TAL doo k poor loo-GAH-resh k reh-veh-LANG deh-TAH-ly owsh POH-koosh KWAN-too mysh TEM-poo fee-KAH-moosh kong AY-loosh

exampleSentences.portuguese: Há sítios que impressionam logo e outros que ficam melhor na memória.
exampleSentences.english: There are places that impress immediately and others that stay better in the memory.

subject: Weather, Seasons & Nature
english: I find rain comforting when I am inside, but much less romantic when I still have to get somewhere on foot.
portuguese: Acho a chuva reconfortante quando estou dentro, mas muito menos romântica quando ainda tenho de chegar a algum lado a pé.
pronunciationNote: AH-shoo ah SHOO-vah reh-kon-for-TAN-t KWAN-doo esh-TOH DEN-troo, mahz MOOY-too MEN-oosh roh-MAN-tee-kah KWAN-doo een-DAH TEN-yoo d sheh-GAR ah al-GOOM LAH-doo ah PEH

exampleSentences.portuguese: Da janela tem graça; debaixo dela nem tanto.
exampleSentences.english: From the window it is charming; under it, not so much.

subject: Weather, Seasons & Nature
english: The more I go outside, the more I notice that each season has its own rhythm rather than just its own temperature.
portuguese: Quanto mais saio, mais noto que cada estação tem o seu próprio ritmo e não apenas a sua temperatura.
pronunciationNote: KWAN-too mysh SAI-oo, mysh NOH-too k KAH-dah esh-tah-SOWN teng oo say-oo PROH-pree-oo REET-moo ee nown ah-PEH-nash ah soo-ah tem-peh-rah-TOO-rah

exampleSentences.portuguese: A luz, os cheiros e o som dos lugares também mudam muito.
exampleSentences.english: The light, the smells, and the sound of places also change a lot.

subject: Weather, Seasons & Nature
english: I do not need dramatic scenery if the atmosphere of a place feels coherent and grounded.
portuguese: Não preciso de uma paisagem dramática se a atmosfera de um lugar me parecer coerente e assente.
pronunciationNote: nown preh-SEE-zoo d OO-mah pie-ZAH-zheng drah-MAH-tee-kah s ah ah-tmohs-FEH-rah d oom loo-GAR m pah-REH-sair koo-eh-REN-t ee ah-SEN-t

exampleSentences.portuguese: Há beleza em sítios discretos quando tudo ali parece encaixar.
exampleSentences.english: There is beauty in quiet places when everything there seems to fit.

subject: Weather, Seasons & Nature
english: What tires me most in bad weather is not the rain itself, but the constant need to adjust around it.
portuguese: O que mais me cansa no mau tempo não é a chuva em si, mas a necessidade constante de estar sempre a ajustar tudo à volta dela.
pronunciationNote: oo k mysh m KAN-sah noo mao TEM-poo nown eh ah SHOO-vah eng s, mahz ah neh-seh-see-DAH-d konsh-TAN-t d esh-TAR SAYM-pr ah ah-zhoosh-TAR TOO-doo ah VOL-tah DEH-lah

exampleSentences.portuguese: Roupa, transportes e planos ficam logo mais complicados.
exampleSentences.english: Clothes, transport, and plans all immediately get more complicated.

subject: Weather, Seasons & Nature
english: I prefer walking in cold, bright weather to walking in warm, heavy weather.
portuguese: Prefiro caminhar com frio e luz a caminhar com calor e tempo pesado.
pronunciationNote: preh-FEE-roo kah-mee-NYAR kong FREE-oo ee looz ah kah-mee-NYAR kong kah-LOR ee TEM-poo peh-ZAH-doo

exampleSentences.portuguese: Se o ar estiver leve, aguento muito melhor o passeio.
exampleSentences.english: If the air feels light, I handle the walk much better.

subject: Weather, Seasons & Nature
english: The places I remember best are often the ones where the weather became part of the experience instead of just the background.
portuguese: Os sítios de que me lembro melhor são muitas vezes aqueles em que o tempo passou a fazer parte da experiência e não apenas de fundo.
pronunciationNote: oosh SEE-tee-oosh d k m LEM-broo meh-LYOR sown MOOY-tash VAY-zesh ah-KEH-loosh eng k oo TEM-poo pah-SOH ah fah-ZAIR PAR-t dah eks-peh-ree-EN-see-ah ee nown ah-PEH-nash d FOON-doo
notes: Useful in travel and nature conversation.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Nalguns lugares, a neblina ou o vento mudam completamente a forma como os guardamos na memória.
exampleSentences.english: In some places, fog or wind completely change how we keep them in memory.

subject: Weather, Seasons & Nature
english: I like forecasts that are specific enough to be useful without pretending to be more certain than they really are.
portuguese: Gosto de previsões que sejam específicas o suficiente para ajudar, sem fingirem ter mais certeza do que têm na realidade.
pronunciationNote: GOSH-too d preh-vee-SOINSH k ZHAY-ang esh-peh-SEE-fee-kash oo soo-fee-see-EN-t PAH-rah ah-zhoo-DAR, seng feen-ZHEE-reng tair mysh ser-TEH-zah doo k TAYNG nah rreh-ah-lee-DAH-d

exampleSentences.portuguese: Prefiro uma previsão honesta a uma precisão falsa.
exampleSentences.english: I prefer an honest forecast to false precision.

subject: Weather, Seasons & Nature
english: The countryside feels most alive to me when you can hear both wind and small human activity at the same time.
portuguese: O campo parece-me mais vivo quando se ouve ao mesmo tempo o vento e a pequena atividade humana.
pronunciationNote: oo KAHM-poo pah-REH-s-m mysh VEE-voo KWAN-doo s OO-veh ow MAYZ-moo TEM-poo oo VEN-too ee ah peh-KEH-nah ah-tee-vee-DAH-d oo-MAH-nah

exampleSentences.portuguese: Esse equilíbrio faz-me sentir que o lugar respira.
exampleSentences.english: That balance makes me feel the place is breathing.

subject: Weather, Seasons & Nature
english: I do not usually choose destinations by season alone, but the time of year can completely change how a place reads.
portuguese: Não costumo escolher destinos só pela estação, mas a altura do ano pode mudar completamente a leitura de um lugar.
pronunciationNote: nown koosh-TOO-mah esh-koh-LYAIR desh-TEE-noosh soh PEL-ah esh-tah-SOWN, mahz ah al-TOO-rah doo AH-noo PODE moo-DAR kong-pleh-tah-MEN-t ah lay-TOO-rah d oom loo-GAR

exampleSentences.portuguese: A mesma paisagem pode parecer aberta, dura, tranquila ou melancólica consoante a luz.
exampleSentences.english: The same landscape can seem open, harsh, calm, or melancholic depending on the light.

subject: Weather, Seasons & Nature
english: I appreciate places where shade, water, and wind are part of how people actually live with the climate.
portuguese: Dou valor a lugares onde a sombra, a água e o vento fazem parte da forma como as pessoas realmente vivem com o clima.
pronunciationNote: doh vah-LOR ah loo-GAH-resh ON-d ah SOHM-brah, ah AH-gwah ee oo VEN-too FAH-zeng PAR-t dah FOR-mah KOH-moo az peh-SOH-ash rreh-al-MEN-t VEE-veng kong oo KLEE-mah
notes: Useful in place and climate discussions.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Nesses sítios, a arquitetura e o ambiente parecem conversar um com o outro.
exampleSentences.english: In those places, architecture and environment seem to speak to each other.

subject: Weather, Seasons & Nature
english: What I miss most in dense urban life is not silence exactly, but the sense of distance and open air.
portuguese: O que mais me faz falta na vida urbana densa não é exatamente o silêncio, mas a sensação de distância e de ar aberto.
pronunciationNote: oo k mysh m faz FAL-tah nah VEE-dah oor-BAH-nah DEN-sah nown eh eh-zak-tah-MEN-t oo see-LEN-see-oo, mahz ah sen-sah-SOWN d deesh-TAN-see-ah ee d ar ah-BEHR-too
notes: Useful in conversations about city and nature.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Mesmo quando a cidade está calma, o corpo nota essa diferença.
exampleSentences.english: Even when the city is calm, the body notices that difference.

subject: Weather, Seasons & Nature
english: If I have to choose between a perfect view and a place that feels physically comfortable, I often choose comfort.
portuguese: Se tiver de escolher entre uma vista perfeita e um lugar fisicamente confortável, muitas vezes escolho o conforto.
pronunciationNote: s tee-VAIR d esh-koh-LYAIR EN-tr OO-mah VEESH-tah pair-FAY-tah ee oom loo-GAR fee-see-kah-MEN-t kon-for-TAH-vel, MOOY-tash VAY-zesh esh-KOL-yoo oo kon-FOR-too
notes: Useful in travel and outdoor planning.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Se estou a tremer ou a assar, nem a paisagem me prende tanto.
exampleSentences.english: If I am freezing or roasting, not even the landscape holds me that much.

subject: Weather, Seasons & Nature
english: I like weather that makes you notice your surroundings more clearly, not weather that turns the day into a logistical problem.
portuguese: Gosto de tempo que nos faz reparar melhor no que nos rodeia, e não de tempo que transforma o dia num problema logístico.
pronunciationNote: GOSH-too d TEM-poo k noosh faz rreh-pah-RAR meh-LYOR noo k noosh roh-DAY-ah, ee nown d TEM-poo k transh-FOR-mah oo dee-ah noom proh-BLAY-mah loh-ZHEES-tee-koo

exampleSentences.portuguese: Uma ligeira mudança de luz pode abrir os olhos; uma tempestade só fecha planos.
exampleSentences.english: A slight shift of light can open your eyes; a storm just shuts plans down.

subject: Weather, Seasons & Nature
english: I have more patience for cold if the air is dry and the sky is clear.
portuguese: Tenho mais paciência para o frio se o ar estiver seco e o céu limpo.
pronunciationNote: TEN-yoo mysh pah-see-EN-see-ah PAH-rah oo FREE-oo s oo ar esh-TEE-vair SEH-koo ee oo SEH-oo LEEM-poo

exampleSentences.portuguese: O frio húmido custa-me muito mais do que o frio nítido.
exampleSentences.english: Damp cold is much harder for me than crisp cold.

subject: Weather, Seasons & Nature
english: The sea can calm me down, but it can also make me feel very small in a useful way.
portuguese: O mar pode acalmar-me, mas também me pode fazer sentir muito pequeno de uma forma útil.
pronunciationNote: oo mar PODE ah-kahl-MAR-m, mahz tam-BAYNG m PODE fah-ZAIR seen-TEER MOOY-too peh-KEH-noo d OO-mah FOR-mah OO-teel

exampleSentences.portuguese: Põe as coisas em perspetiva sem eu precisar de pensar muito.
exampleSentences.english: It puts things in perspective without my needing to think too much.

subject: Weather, Seasons & Nature
english: The kind of place I return to is usually one where the weather can change the mood without destroying the visit.
portuguese: O tipo de lugar a que volto costuma ser aquele onde o tempo muda o ambiente sem estragar a visita.
pronunciationNote: oo TEE-poo d loo-GAR ah k VOL-too koosh-TOO-mah sair ah-KEH-l ON-d oo TEM-poo MOO-dah oo am-bee-EN-t seng esh-trah-GAR ah vee-ZEE-tah

exampleSentences.portuguese: Se um sítio só funciona com perfeição meteorológica, para mim perde profundidade.
exampleSentences.english: If a place only works in perfect weather, it loses depth for me.

subject: Weather, Seasons & Nature
english: I often enjoy winter landscapes precisely because they strip things back and make structure more visible.
portuguese: Gosto muitas vezes de paisagens de inverno precisamente porque retiram excesso e tornam a estrutura mais visível.
pronunciationNote: GOSH-too MOOY-tash VAY-zesh d pie-ZAH-zhensh d een-VAIR-noo preh-see-zah-MEN-t poor-k rreh-TEE-rang eks-SEH-soo ee TOR-nang ah esh-troo-TOO-rah mysh vee-ZEE-vel

exampleSentences.portuguese: Sem tanto verde ou distração, nota-se melhor a forma do lugar.
exampleSentences.english: Without so much green or distraction, the shape of the place becomes clearer.

subject: Weather, Seasons & Nature
english: I try not to idealise nature too much, because part of what I value is how specific and local it feels.
portuguese: Tento não idealizar demasiado a natureza, porque parte do que valorizo é o facto de ela parecer específica e local.
pronunciationNote: TEN-too nown ee-deh-ah-lee-ZAR deh-mah-zee-AH-doo ah nah-too-reh-zah, poor-k PAR-t doo k vah-loh-REE-zoo eh oo FAK-too d EH-lah pah-REH-sair esh-peh-SEE-fee-kah ee loh-KAL

exampleSentences.portuguese: Gosto mais quando um lugar é ele mesmo do que quando tenta parecer intocado em abstrato.
exampleSentences.english: I prefer when a place is simply itself rather than trying to seem abstractly untouched.

subject: Weather, Seasons & Nature
english: The weather can completely alter the scale of a landscape, making it feel either intimate or exposed.
portuguese: O tempo pode alterar completamente a escala de uma paisagem, fazendo-a parecer íntima ou exposta.
pronunciationNote: oo TEM-poo PODE al-teh-RAR kong-pleh-tah-MEN-t ah ES-kah-lah d OO-mah pie-ZAH-zheng, fah-ZENG-doo-ah pah-REH-sair EEN-tee-mah oo eks-POHS-tah

exampleSentences.portuguese: A mesma serra pode acolher num dia e afastar no seguinte.
exampleSentences.english: The same mountain range can feel welcoming one day and distant the next.

subject: Weather, Seasons & Nature
english: I do not always need sunshine to enjoy being outside; I just need the weather to feel inhabitable.
portuguese: Nem sempre preciso de sol para gostar de estar lá fora; só preciso que o tempo pareça habitável.
pronunciationNote: neng SAYM-pr preh-SEE-zoo d sol PAH-rah gosh-TAR d esh-TAR lah FOR-ah; soh preh-SEE-zoo k oo TEM-poo pah-REH-sah ah-bee-TAH-vel

exampleSentences.portuguese: Luz suave e ar fresco muitas vezes chegam perfeitamente.
exampleSentences.english: Soft light and fresh air are often more than enough.

subject: Weather, Seasons & Nature
english: The best walks for me are the ones where the landscape keeps changing just enough to reset my attention.
portuguese: Os melhores passeios para mim são aqueles em que a paisagem vai mudando o suficiente para me renovar a atenção.
pronunciationNote: oosh meh-LYOH-resh pah-SAY-oosh PAH-rah meeng sown ah-KEH-loosh eng k ah pie-ZAH-zheng vy moo-DAN-doo oo soo-fee-see-EN-t PAH-rah m rreh-noh-VAR ah ah-ten-SOWN
notes: Useful in hiking and nature talk.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Quando tudo se repete demasiado, deixo de reparar realmente.
exampleSentences.english: When everything repeats too much, I stop truly noticing.

subject: Weather, Seasons & Nature
english: There is a kind of winter light that makes even ordinary places feel more precise.
portuguese: Há um tipo de luz de inverno que faz até os lugares comuns parecerem mais precisos.
pronunciationNote: AH oom TEE-poo d looz d een-VAIR-noo k faz ah-TAY oosh loo-GAH-resh koh-MOONGSH pah-REH-sair-eng mysh preh-SEE-soosh

exampleSentences.portuguese: As sombras ficam mais nítidas e tudo parece ganhar contorno.
exampleSentences.english: The shadows become sharper and everything seems to gain outline.

subject: Weather, Seasons & Nature
english: I think people sometimes underestimate how much weather shapes social life in subtle ways.
portuguese: Acho que as pessoas por vezes subestimam o quanto o tempo molda a vida social de formas subtis.
pronunciationNote: AH-shoo k az peh-SOH-ash poor VAY-zesh soo-behsh-tee-MANG oo KWAN-too oo TEM-poo MOL-dah ah VEE-dah soh-see-AL d FOR-mash soob-TEESH

exampleSentences.portuguese: Muda o ritmo das conversas, dos encontros e até da vontade de sair.
exampleSentences.english: It changes the rhythm of conversations, meetings, and even the desire to go out.

subject: Weather, Seasons & Nature
english: The landscapes I trust most are the ones that still have character when the weather turns flat.
portuguese: As paisagens em que mais confio são as que ainda têm caráter quando o tempo fica plano.
pronunciationNote: azh pie-ZAH-zhensh eng k mysh kon-FEE-oo sown az k een-DAH TAYNG kah-RAK-ter KWAN-doo oo TEM-poo FEE-kah PLAH-noo

exampleSentences.portuguese: Se um lugar só resulta com o filtro certo, talvez não tenha tanta força assim.
exampleSentences.english: If a place only works with the right filter, perhaps it is not that strong.

subject: Weather, Seasons & Nature
english: I usually notice nature most clearly when I stop trying to have an experience and just pay attention to what is already there.
portuguese: Costumo reparar mais claramente na natureza quando deixo de tentar ter uma experiência e simplesmente presto atenção ao que já está ali.
pronunciationNote: koosh-TOO-mah rreh-pah-RAR mysh klah-RAH-men-t nah nah-too-reh-zah KWAN-doo DAY-shoo d ten-TAR tair OO-mah eks-peh-ree-EN-see-ah ee seem-plehz-MEN-t PREHSH-too ah-ten-SOWN ow k zhah esh-TAH ah-LEE

exampleSentences.portuguese: Muitas vezes o mais forte é aquilo que não estávamos à espera de notar.
exampleSentences.english: Often the strongest thing is what we were not expecting to notice.

subject: Weather, Seasons & Nature
english: I prefer trails that feel varied rather than technically impressive but monotonous.
portuguese: Prefiro trilhos que parecem variados em vez de tecnicamente impressionantes mas monótonos.
pronunciationNote: preh-FEE-roo TREE-lyoosh k pah-REH-seng vah-ree-AH-doosh eng vez d tek-nee-kah-MEN-t eem-presh-see-oh-NAN-tesh mahz moh-NOH-toh-noosh

exampleSentences.portuguese: Se o caminho me surpreende aos poucos, fico muito mais presente.
exampleSentences.english: If the path keeps surprising me gradually, I stay much more present.

subject: Weather, Seasons & Nature
english: The right kind of wind can make a place feel alive, but too much of it makes everything feel defensive.
portuguese: O tipo certo de vento pode dar vida a um lugar, mas vento a mais faz tudo parecer defensivo.
pronunciationNote: oo TEE-poo SER-too d VEN-too PODE dar VEE-dah ah oom loo-GAR, mahz VEN-too ah mysh faz TOO-doo pah-REH-sair deh-feng-SEE-voo
notes: Useful in coastal and mountain talk.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Uma brisa abre o espaço; uma rajada constante fecha-o.
exampleSentences.english: A breeze opens the space up; a constant gust closes it down.

subject: Weather, Seasons & Nature
english: I often feel closer to a place in off-season months, when it is not performing itself for visitors.
portuguese: Muitas vezes sinto-me mais próximo de um lugar fora de época, quando não está a representar-se para visitantes.
pronunciationNote: MOOY-tash VAY-zesh SEEN-too-m mysh PROHk-see-moo d oom loo-GAR FOR-ah d EH-poh-kah, KWAN-doo nown esh-TAH ah rreh-preh-zeng-TAR-s PAH-rah vee-zee-TAN-tesh

exampleSentences.portuguese: Sem tanta pressa ou ruído, noto melhor a sua textura real.
exampleSentences.english: Without so much rush or noise, I notice its real texture better.

subject: Weather, Seasons & Nature
english: I do not need nature to feel untouched; I need it to feel honest.
portuguese: Não preciso que a natureza pareça intocada; preciso que pareça honesta.
pronunciationNote: nown preh-SEE-zoo k ah nah-too-reh-zah pah-REH-sah een-toh-KAH-dah; preh-SEE-zoo k pah-REH-sah oh-NESH-tah

exampleSentences.portuguese: Para mim, isso vale mais do que uma ideia romântica de pureza.
exampleSentences.english: For me, that matters more than a romantic idea of purity.

subject: Weather, Seasons & Nature
english: What I enjoy most about autumn is the sense of transition without the exhaustion of full summer heat.
portuguese: O que mais gosto no outono é a sensação de transição sem o desgaste do calor forte do verão.
pronunciationNote: oo k mysh GOSH-too noo ow-TOH-noo eh ah sen-sah-SOWN d trans-ee-SOWN seng oo dezh-GASH-t doo kah-LOR FOR-t doo veh-ROWN

exampleSentences.portuguese: Parece um tempo mais respirável sem perder totalmente a luz.
exampleSentences.english: It feels like more breathable weather without losing the light completely.

subject: Weather, Seasons & Nature
english: A place feels richer to me when the weather changes how you move through it rather than just how it looks.
portuguese: Um lugar parece-me mais rico quando o tempo muda a forma como nos movemos por ele e não apenas a forma como ele se mostra.
pronunciationNote: oom loo-GAR pah-REH-s-m mysh RREE-koo KWAN-doo oo TEM-poo MOO-dah ah FOR-mah KOH-moo noosh moh-VAY-moosh poor EH-l ee nown ah-PEH-nash ah FOR-mah KOH-moo EH-l s MOHSH-trah
notes: Useful in travel and outdoor conversation.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Se o clima muda o ritmo do corpo, o lugar entra mais fundo na memória.
exampleSentences.english: If the climate changes the body's rhythm, the place goes deeper into memory.

subject: Weather, Seasons & Nature
english: I generally trust my own sense of the sky more once I have spent time in the same region.
portuguese: Costumo confiar mais na minha leitura do céu depois de passar algum tempo na mesma região.
pronunciationNote: koosh-TOO-mah kon-fee-AR mysh nah MEE-nyah lay-TOO-rah doo SEH-oo deh-POYSH d pah-SAR al-GOOM TEM-poo nah MAYZ-mah rreh-zhee-OWN

exampleSentences.portuguese: Ao fim de algum tempo, aprende-se a notar sinais pequenos.
exampleSentences.english: After a while, you learn to notice small signs.

subject: Weather, Seasons & Nature
english: The kind of cold I enjoy is the kind that sharpens things, not the kind that seeps into everything.
portuguese: O frio de que gosto é aquele que afia as coisas, e não aquele que se mete em tudo.
pronunciationNote: oo FREE-oo d k GOSH-too eh ah-KEH-l k ah-FEE-ah az KOY-zash, ee nown ah-KEH-l k s MEH-t eng TOO-doo

exampleSentences.portuguese: Uma coisa é acordar; outra é ficar preso ao desconforto o dia inteiro.
exampleSentences.english: One thing is waking up; another is being trapped in discomfort all day.

subject: Weather, Seasons & Nature
english: I appreciate paths that make room for pauses, views, and changes in pace rather than only for progress.
portuguese: Dou valor a caminhos que deixam espaço para pausas, vistas e mudanças de ritmo, e não apenas para avançar.
pronunciationNote: doh vah-LOR ah kah-MEE-nyoosh k DAY-shang esh-PAH-soo PAH-rah POW-zash, VEESH-tash ee moo-DAN-sash d REET-moo, ee nown ah-PEH-nash PAH-rah ah-vahn-SAR
notes: Useful in walking and hiking conversations.

exampleSentences.portuguese: O passeio sabe melhor quando o corpo e o olhar podem ajustar-se.
exampleSentences.english: A walk feels better when the body and the gaze can adjust.

subject: Weather, Seasons & Nature
english: There is a certain kind of mist that does not hide a landscape so much as simplify it.
portuguese: Há um certo tipo de neblina que não esconde tanto uma paisagem como a simplifica.
pronunciationNote: AH oom SER-too TEE-poo d neh-BLEE-nah k nown esh-KON-d TAN-too OO-mah pie-ZAH-zheng KOH-moo ah seem-plee-FEE-kah

exampleSentences.portuguese: De repente, só ficam as linhas principais e tudo ganha outro peso.
exampleSentences.english: Suddenly, only the main lines remain and everything takes on a different weight.

subject: Weather, Seasons & Nature
english: If I stay long enough in one place, I start noticing not just the view but the pattern of the weather itself.
portuguese: Se fico tempo suficiente num lugar, começo a notar não só a vista mas também o próprio padrão do tempo.
pronunciationNote: s FEE-koo TEM-poo soo-fee-see-EN-t noom loo-GAR, koh-MEH-soo ah noh-TAR nown soh ah VEESH-tah mahz tam-BAYNG oo PROH-pree-oo pah-DROWN doo TEM-poo

exampleSentences.portuguese: A paisagem deixa de ser só imagem e passa a ter comportamento.
exampleSentences.english: The landscape stops being just an image and starts having behaviour.

subject: Weather, Seasons & Nature
english: Good outdoor weather, for me, is weather that lets the body relax without making the mind sleepy.
portuguese: Bom tempo para estar lá fora, para mim, é o tempo que deixa o corpo relaxar sem adormecer a cabeça.
pronunciationNote: bong TEM-poo PAH-rah esh-TAR lah FOR-ah, PAH-rah meeng, eh oo TEM-poo k DAY-shah oo KOR-poo rreh-lah-SHAR seng ah-dor-meh-SAIR ah kah-BEH-sah

exampleSentences.portuguese: Quero energia calma, não torpor nem irritação.
exampleSentences.english: I want calm energy, not sluggishness or irritation.

subject: Weather, Seasons & Nature
english: I like places where you can sense the season not only visually, but also in smell, sound, and movement.
portuguese: Gosto de lugares onde se sente a estação não só visualmente, mas também no cheiro, no som e no movimento.
pronunciationNote: GOSH-too d loo-GAH-resh ON-d s SEN-t ah esh-tah-SOWN nown soh vee-zhoo-al-MEN-t, mahz tam-BAYNG noo SHAY-roo, noo som ee noo moh-vee-MEN-too

exampleSentences.portuguese: Quando tudo muda em conjunto, a estação torna-se muito mais real.
exampleSentences.english: When everything changes together, the season becomes much more real.

subject: Weather, Seasons & Nature
english: I do not think comfort and wildness are opposites; the best places often hold both at once.
portuguese: Não acho que conforto e lado selvagem sejam opostos; os melhores lugares muitas vezes têm os dois ao mesmo tempo.
pronunciationNote: nown AH-shoo k kon-FOR-too ee LAH-doo sel-VAH-zheng ZHAY-ang oh-POH-stoosh; oosh meh-LYOH-resh loo-GAH-resh MOOY-tash VAY-zesh TAYNG oosh DOYSH ow MAYZ-moo TEM-poo
notes: Useful in nature and travel discussions.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Uma margem acessível pode ainda assim dar-nos a sensação de abertura e risco.
exampleSentences.english: An accessible riverbank can still give us a feeling of openness and risk.

subject: Weather, Seasons & Nature
english: I find that weather becomes more interesting the less I ask it to match my plans perfectly.
portuguese: Acho que o tempo se torna mais interessante quanto menos lhe peço que combine perfeitamente com os meus planos.
pronunciationNote: AH-shoo k oo TEM-poo s TOR-nah mysh een-teh-reh-SAN-t KWAN-too MEN-oosh lyeh PESSH-oo k kong-BEE-neh pair-fay-tah-MEN-t kong oosh MAY-oosh PLAH-noosh

exampleSentences.portuguese: Quando deixo margem para adaptação, noto muito mais do lugar em si.
exampleSentences.english: When I leave room for adaptation, I notice much more of the place itself.

subject: Weather, Seasons & Nature
english: The older I get, the more I value nature less as spectacle and more as calibration.
portuguese: Quanto mais velho fico, mais valorizo a natureza menos como espetáculo e mais como forma de me recalibrar.
pronunciationNote: KWAN-too mysh VEL-yoo FEE-koo, mysh vah-loh-REE-zoo ah nah-too-reh-zah MEN-oosh KOH-moo esh-peh-TAH-koo-loo ee mysh KOH-moo FOR-mah d m rreh-kah-lee-BRAR

exampleSentences.portuguese: Nem sempre preciso de deslumbramento; muitas vezes preciso só de me recentrar.
exampleSentences.english: I do not always need wonder; often I just need to recenter myself.

subject: Weather, Seasons & Nature
english: If a landscape stays with me afterwards, it is usually because the weather, the light, and my state of mind all lined up for a moment.
portuguese: Se uma paisagem fica comigo depois, é geralmente porque o tempo, a luz e o meu estado de espírito se alinharam por um momento.
pronunciationNote: s OO-mah pie-ZAH-zheng FEE-kah kon-TEE-goo deh-POYSH, eh zheh-rahl-MEN-t poor-k oo TEM-poo, ah looz ee oo may-oo esh-TAH-doo d esh-PEE-ree-too s ah-lee-NYAH-rang poor oom moo-MEN-too
notes: Useful in reflective and descriptive conversation.

exampleSentences.portuguese: Não foi só o lugar; foi a coincidência certa entre o lugar e quem eu era naquele instante.
exampleSentences.english: It was not just the place; it was the right coincidence between the place and who I was in that moment.
